parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation or documented visitor-facing border, detention, or facility exclusion is present; gender identity is protected in goods, services, education, and health, and civic acceptance is visible. Offsets are unresolved entry/screening/facility practice and rising reported anti-LGBT hate incidents with no hate-crime offence. Resident gaps (minor care restrictions, pending conversion-practice ban) are climate signals, not direct visitor rules. Overall low risk, with uncertainty rather than documented exposure.

entry_documents.exposure: No sourced rule requiring marker/appearance match, refusing entry, or screening binders; entry, visa, and passport-marker handling are explicitly unresolved.
entry_documents.protection: No trans-specific entry ban is documented; general anti-discrimination law does not reach border discretion as sourced.
entry_documents.interaction: Foreign passport and presentation could meet unsourced officer discretion; safe border practice cannot be assumed.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: No trans-specific offence or documented visitor detention/custody placement by birth sex; the criminal code has no hate-crime category.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Same-sex conduct and trans identity are not criminalised; general assault law applies.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Without a trans offence, discovery should not trigger prosecution; custody conditions for trans visitors remain unsourced.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No subnational variation documented; gendered facility access such as bathrooms, wards, and custody is unsourced.
federal_state_facilities.protection: National equality law covers goods, services, and health; no evidence of a facility-exclusion rule.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Facility staff discretion could vary, but no documented visitor-facing ban is shown.

care_services.exposure: Visitor access to trans care is not sourced. Resident survey: over 40% of trans respondents could not access needed care, undated; minor care recommendations restrict blockers/hormones.
care_services.protection: Gender-identity discrimination in health services has been prohibited since 2014; conversion practices were first prosecuted as assault.
care_services.interaction: Adult visitors may rely on anti-discrimination; minor visitor care access is unresolved, while resident restrictions are climate.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No state campaign or law frames trans people as a threat; reported anti-LGBT hate incidents rose, with 241 in the sexual-orientation/gender-identity category and no criminal hate-crime offence.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Police record hate motives; assault and anti-discrimination laws provide general recourse.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hate figures are reported suspicions, not charges; no evidence of police targeting trans visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: No minor-specific visitor rule is sourced; resident gender care for under-25s is centralised and medically restricted by 2020 recommendations.
minors_guardians.protection: No documented border or facility rule targets trans minors; general anti-discrimination covers education and health.
minors_guardians.interaction: A trans minor travelling with a guardian faces no sourced visitor exposure; care access abroad remains uncertain.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Reported anti-LGBT hate incidents are at a recorded high; 2018 assault counts and 2019 youth-violence findings are dated and LGBT-wide, not trans-specific rates.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Police record hate motives; assault law and anti-discrimination remedies exist; the first conversion case was prosecuted.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: No denominator or trans-specific rate exists; recourse depends on reporting and the general criminal process.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No hate-crime offence; motive is recorded only in police reports. Enforcement of visitor-facing anti-discrimination and border/facility practice is not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Equality statute covers services and health; police record hate crimes; civil society and Pride visibility are active.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Paper protections exist, but an operational remedy for a trans visitor is unproven; unresolved issues are lighter than documented exposure.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar national equality and social tolerance, but 0.85-A documents police training, independent oversight and working visitor remedies; this dossier lacks those and has rising hate-crime reports, so it sits below.

0.75-C documents border training, an appeal tribunal and brief detention practice; this dossier has stronger general anti-discrimination but no sourced border practice, so it is roughly comparable or slightly above because no trans visitor detention is documented.
0.65-A contains a documented intrusive stop and inconsistent rural enforcement; this dossier has no documented trans visitor incident and broader gender-identity protections, so it is above.
0.95-A has audited border conduct and a dedicated ombuds office; this dossier lacks those visitor-facing mechanisms and leaves entry and facilities unresolved, so it is materially below.

parsed.synthesis: The combined regime is legally protective: no trans or same-sex criminalisation, gender-identity anti-discrimination in services and health, police hate-crime recording, and visible civic acceptance. No documented visitor-facing ban, border refusal, custody rule, or facility exclusion exists. Countervailing evidence is societal and recourse-related: reported anti-LGBT hate incidents are at a recorded high, no hate-crime offence exists, and conversion-practice legislation remains pending. Entry, screening, and facility practice are unresolved, but in a well-documented state silence is moderately positive, not proof of danger. Resident gaps such as minor care restrictions and the legacy sterilisation cohort do not directly reach a visitor. The score is low risk, not aspirational.
